subject: Users cannot log in through SSO
body: Multiple employees are unable to log into the platform through our SSO provider. They are receiving authentication errors with SAML response validation failure.

subject: Analytics dashboard is extremely slow
body: Dashboard pages are taking more than 30 seconds to load. The issue is affecting our team's ability to complete daily reporting work.

subject: Request: bulk archive operations
body: We currently have to archive records one at a time. We need the ability to select multiple records and archive them in bulk. Current workaround is manually processing each record.

subject: Severe ingestion failures - cancel our contract if not resolved
body: This continuous pipeline downtime is completely unacceptable. We are actively evaluating competing vendor alternatives and will not renew or will cancel our contract unless our TAM intervenes immediately.

subject: Executive escalation: Business continuity at risk
body: Please escalate immediately to senior management. Our warehouse dispatch workflows have stopped due to connector stalls, and business continuity at risk across three fulfillment centers.

subject: Production outage on automated trigger engine
body: The service is down and all users in our organisation are unable to process shipments. Production workflows have stopped completely.

subject: How do I update notification settings?
body: I would like to change the notification settings for my account. Please explain where this can be configured.

subject: Database connector pool exhaustion warning
body: We are getting intermittent connection pool exhaustion warnings during peak morning ingestion hours.

subject: Scheduled report PDF rendering delay inquiry
body: Our scheduled executive weekly digest took approximately 4 minutes to generate today. Could we optimize the render timeout?

subject: Inquiry regarding KMS key rotation schedule
body: We would like to confirm our automated 90-day KMS key rotation procedure and verify audit trail compliance for our annual HIPAA review.
